prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one standalone transparent page-heading spot illustration, intended to be displayed at 84 by 84 pixels. Use the supplied paper-rhythm illustration only as the precise art-direction reference. Create a new sister illustration with a different main subject. Match its hand-crafted layered paper construction, delicate oil-paint and colored-pencil surface grain, soft dimensional folded edges, restrained warm light, ivory cream paper, a few deep cobalt blue paper leaves, one muted golden circular paper accent, and a small vermilion ribbon accent. Keep the same refined editorial craft aesthetic and limited palette; avoid glossy 3D, vector icons, photography, excessive scenery or decoration.
Composition: a square canvas with a single coherent compact arrangement centered within it, occupying about 85 percent of canvas width and height with an even transparent safety margin. Strong recognizable silhouette and only a few large forms that remain clear at 84 pixels. All elements belong to this one scene. Truly transparent alpha background, including between separate pieces; no opaque backdrop, no ground rectangle, no checkerboard baked into image. No text, no letters, no numbers, no writing, no watermark. Never make a sprite sheet, grid, atlas, collection or multiple alternatives.
Main subject: three small cream paper portrait cards forming one compact triangular network, connected by three elegant fine dark-blue threads. Each card contains only a simple dimensional paper human bust silhouette, not realistic faces and no names. Use one small golden circular backing accent, a minimal blue paper leaf accent and one short vermilion ribbon tab. This represents people and their relationships; keep the portrait cards large enough to read at 84 pixels and the connecting threads clearly visible.
